svg.title: Unrooted trees and layered metadata (synthetic)
svg.desc: A karyon sheet of 2 panels in 2 columns: panel A, A topology-balanced centre removes the arbitrary Newick root while leaders preserve unequal branch lengths; panel B, Colour strips, radial bars, binary marks and shaped categories retain exact values in tooltips.
